remarks: Welcome to Heights Crossing, Darien's premier luxury apartment community offering upscale living with unmatched convenience. Perfectly positioned directly across from the Metro North train station, Heights Crossing offers effortless access to New York City while nestled in a vibrant coastal town. This newly constructed 1-bedroom, 1-bath residence with a private office blends refined design with modern functionality. The thoughtfully designed layout features an open-concept floor plan and a full wrap-around balcony off the living room through elegant French doors, flooding the space with natural light. The eat-in kitchen is beautifully appointed with Quartz countertops, a bar-height island, custom cabinetry, GE appliances, and a designer tile backsplash.  In addition to the spacious bedroom with an expansive walk-in closet, the unit includes a private office or flex space, ideal for guests, working from home, or creative use. An in-unit washer and dryer and luxury vinyl tile flooring throughout add comfort and convenience.  Designed for peace and privacy, the building features enhanced soundproofing between floors and high-performance exterior insulation. Residents will also enjoy a beautifully landscaped fountain courtyard with retail shopping below. Just moments from the Noroton Heights shopping district, grocery store, and pharmacy, with Darien's beaches and Great Island only a short drive away, Heights Crossing delivers coastal luxury reimagined.
